findings.pattern: A public research screen exposed AI, market and operator-looking affordances that did not belong to its task.
findings.semanticTest: Public interaction must be limited to the OSINT map, its layer controls, filters, search, news, and source-derived health state.
findings.replacement: Public runtime conditionally removes private panels, market/AI triggers and ticker while preserving the map task.

findings.pattern: Time Machine presented configuration affordances to a visitor who cannot access operator snapshots.
findings.semanticTest: A public boundary must state the access condition rather than simulate a disabled operational workflow.
findings.replacement: A short factual availability message names the local operator runtime without a control or claim of public access.

findings.pattern: The public page mixed a ticker and control-plane chrome into a dense map canvas.
findings.semanticTest: The primary desktop visual hierarchy must remain map → source controls → truthful service state, without decorative operational simulation.
findings.replacement: The final public shell removes ticker/control-plane chrome and keeps named AVDS semantic surfaces around the map.
